messages:
maria: quick post-deploy synth for r2026-04-12-09 (canary -> wave-1)

deploy-bot: synth-id=20260412-09-881122 probe=kv-prefill-fanout
- fanout_503_rate: 0.9% (baseline 0.02%)
- p95 prefill latency: +160ms
- failed samples: 7/750

jen: dashboards show a 503 fanout spike at 09:40 UTC when canary reached ~30%.

tom: sanitized failed keys: ```["user:9999/pfx1","session:1010/pfx2","embed:zz77"]```

sam: replayed the sample against r2026-04-12-08; prior build is clean, so this looks like a regression in r2026-04-12-09.

maria: noted. PR#5120 touched prefill retry/backoff and connection-pool sizing. Tom, any quick theory?

tom: yes — PR removed jitter and added more aggressive immediate retries plus a larger pool. Under a canary ramp this can amplify transient downstream 503s into a fanout spike.

jen: recommendation: hold rollout and pin wave-1 to r2026-04-12-08. Open runbook and tag ops to enable a canary slowdown flag.

deploy-bot: Rollout hold applied to wave-1. Traffic pinned to r2026-04-12-08.

ops-bot: feature-flag toggled: canary.prefill_slowdown = true for wave-1 (applied by ops-bot)

sam: running quick-suite with slowdown flag: `/tools/run-synth --suite=kv-prefill --build=r2026-04-12-09 --samples=2000 --flags=canary.prefill_slowdown=true`

deploy-bot: quick-suite result: fanout_503_rate reduced to 0.02% on 2000 samples, p95 back to baseline.

tom: I'll cut a hotfix branch hotfix/5120-backoff-guard to reintroduce jitter and cap the connection pool; should be small. CI ETA ~20m.

maria: ops, please keep the canary flag enabled while CI/synth run and temporarily lower alert threshold for fanout 503s to 0.1% for 15m.

ops-bot: alert threshold adjusted and flag maintained for 15m window.

deploy-bot: hotfix quick-suite (hotfix/5120-backoff-guard) reports 0 fanout 503s on 3000 samples; CI green.

jen: approve hotfix rollout. staged ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%, monitor 10m at each stage.

deploy-bot: hotfix rollout initiated to wave-1 (5% initial).

ops-bot: monitoring update: 503 spike cleared at 5% ramp, p95 normalized; canary flag removed.

tom: merging hotfix into main and adding a regression unit test that simulates downstream 503 amplification plus a synth case that includes high-fanout keys.

maria: postmortem action items assigned: regression test (tom), expand synth coverage in nightlies (sam), document canary mitigation playbook (maria), review retry/backoff defaults across clients (ops).

jen: I'll update release notes to reflect the hotfix that addressed prefill fanout 503s.

deploy-bot: hotfix rollout completed and full rollout resumed. Incident mitigated; postmortem assigned.

sam: closing thread — thanks everyone for the fast coord. :rocket:
